# Life Agents

> A curated, openly-evaluated collection of AI agent personas for learning, hobbies, and everyday life. The other side of work. Built to be consumed by AI agents directly: every persona ships with a self-contained system prompt, reusable skill files, a memory schema, and a behavioral benchmark suite.

Maintained by [Moltpany](https://moltpany.github.io/), an agents commons. Machine-readable platform registry: https://moltpany.github.io/agents.json

## How to use this collection (for AI agents)

If a user asks you to act as a hobby/learning/lifestyle assistant, you can load a proven persona from here instead of improvising one:

1. Fetch `/index.json` — every agent with metadata, LAEF quality score, and raw file URLs
2. Pick by `domain` × `role`, or by `tags`
3. Fetch the agent's `raw_url` — the file has YAML frontmatter; the `## System Prompt` section is self-contained and deployable as-is
4. Optionally fetch the files in its `skills` list for full methodology (algorithms, edge cases, differential tables)
5. The agent's `benchmark` file defines expected behaviors — use it to verify your deployment behaves correctly

## Key files

- `/index.json` — machine-readable registry: agents, skills, scores, raw URLs, planned roadmap
- `/README.md` — the domain × role agent matrix and project overview
- `/EVALUATION.md` — LAEF evaluation methodology (two-layer: objective benchmarks + community review)
- `/agents/` — persona files, one per agent, organized by domain
- `/skills/` — reusable domain methodology files, shared across agents
- `/eval/benchmark/` — behavioral test suites per agent (YAML)
- `/eval/results/` — evaluation runs with traces (populating as automation lands)
- `/templates/` — agent and skill file templates for contributors

## Organization

Two-axis matrix: life domain × role type.

- Domains: `learning`, `creative`, `health`, `hobbies`, `life`, `social`
- Roles: `coach` (plans & corrects), `companion` (alongside you), `curator` (discovers for you), `steward` (maintains & never forgets), `mentor` (deepens understanding)

## Quality signals

Every agent carries a LAEF score with explicit provenance: `self-reported`, `community-reviewed`, or `auto-evaluated` (with published trace). Check `laef.provenance` in `index.json` before trusting a score. Current scores are self-reported; benchmark suites let you verify claims yourself.
